rawContent: @mike_salter I think one of the (many many) failings of #MeToo is that - as a movement - it's had no clear goals or objectives, beyond mere 'awareness raising' & even that has been open to wide interpretation. It's been ripe for hijacking from all sorts of forces (including media) from get-go
